    SELECT 'sku'::VARCHAR, 'TE3-160BLK35-JP-82'::VARCHAR
    UNION
    SELECT uc.child_kind, uc.child_code
    FROM mapped m
    JOIN u_composition uc
      ON uc.parent_kind = m.kind
     AND uc.parent_code = m.code

      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

JOIN company_model cm

 AND cm.model_code = m.code;

WITH sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT
        s.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku AS s
    JOIN sku_model AS sm
      ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE NOT s.is_bundle

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        bi.qty * sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_item AS bi
    JOIN sales_sku AS item
      ON item.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
     AND NOT item.is_bundle
    JOIN sku_model AS sm
      ON sm.sku_id = item.sku_id
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM orders AS o
JOIN store AS st
  ON st.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN order_line AS ol
  ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN listing AS l
  ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
 AND l.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN sku_to_model AS stm
  ON stm.sku_id = l.sku_id
JOIN company_model AS cm
  ON cm.model_id = stm.model_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND st.country = 'CA'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY cm.model_id, cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(ol.qty * stm.model_qty) DESC, cm.model_code
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE expand(root_sku, kind, code, factor) AS (
    SELECT s.sku_code, 'sku', s.sku_code, 1
    FROM sales_sku s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.root_sku, u.child_kind, u.child_code, e.factor * u.qty
    FROM expand e
    JOIN u_composition u
      ON u.parent_kind = e.kind AND u.parent_code = e.code
    WHERE e.kind = 'sku'
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM order_line ol
JOIN orders o      ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN store st      ON st.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN listing l     ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku s   ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
JOIN expand e      ON e.root_sku = s.sku_code AND e.kind = 'model'
JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_code = e.code
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
  AND st.country = 'CA'
GROUP BY cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(ol.qty * e.factor) DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH sold AS (
    SELECT
        ss.sku_id,
        ol.qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l    ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id

model_units AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: direct mapping to models
    SELECT
        sm.model_id,
        sd.qty * sm.qty AS units
    FROM sold sd
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = sd.sku_id AND ss.is_bundle = FALSE
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = sd.sku_id

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then map to models

        sm.model_id,
        sd.qty * bi.qty * sm.qty AS units

    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = sd.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm   ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM model_units mu

WITH RECURSIVE sold_nodes (order_id, line_no, order_date, node_kind, node_code, units) AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        o.order_date,
        'sku' AS node_kind,
        sk.sku_code AS node_code,
        CAST(ol.qty AS HUGEINT) AS units
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN store AS st
      ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN order_line AS ol
      ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing AS l
      ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
     AND l.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku AS sk
      ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        sn.order_id,
        sn.line_no,
        sn.order_date,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        sn.units * CAST(uc.qty AS HUGEINT)
    FROM sold_nodes AS sn
    JOIN u_composition AS uc
      ON uc.parent_kind = sn.node_kind
     AND uc.parent_code = sn.node_code
     AND uc.valid_from <= sn.order_date
     AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR sn.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE sn.node_kind = 'sku'
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM sold_nodes AS sn
JOIN company_model AS cm
  ON cm.model_code = sn.node_code
WHERE sn.node_kind = 'model'
GROUP BY cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(sn.units) DESC, cm.model_code
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE ordered_skus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.sku_code
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o      ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store st      ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN listing li    ON li.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s   ON s.sku_id = li.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'DE'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
),
explode AS (
    SELECT sku_code AS cur_sku, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS mult
    FROM ordered_skus
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.child_code, e.mult * c.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_code = e.cur_sku AND s.is_bundle
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND c.parent_code = e.cur_sku
     AND c.child_kind  = 'sku'
     AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2024-06-30'
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2024-06-30')
),
sku_model AS (
    SELECT e.cur_sku AS sku_code,
           e.mult,
           m.child_code AS model_code,
           m.qty        AS model_qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_code = e.cur_sku AND NOT s.is_bundle
    JOIN u_composition m
      ON m.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND m.parent_code = e.cur_sku
     AND m.child_kind  = 'model'
     AND m.valid_from <= DATE '2024-06-30'
     AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to >= DATE '2024-06-30')
)
SELECT sm.model_code
FROM order_line ol
JOIN orders o      ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN store st      ON st.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN listing li    ON li.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku s   ON s.sku_id = li.sku_id
JOIN sku_model sm  ON sm.sku_code = s.sku_code
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND st.country = 'DE'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY sm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(ol.qty * sm.mult * sm.model_qty) DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT l.sku_id, ol.qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_date,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o       ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l      ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk   ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN store st       ON st.store_id = o.store_id

      AND st.country = 'UK'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2023-01-01' AND DATE '2023-12-31'
),
model_units AS (
    -- non-bundle SKUs: direct SKU -> model mapping
    SELECT
        s.order_qty AS units,
        m.child_code AS model_code
    FROM sales s
    JOIN u_composition m
      ON m.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND m.parent_code = s.sku_code
     AND m.child_kind = 'model'
     AND m.valid_from <= s.order_date
     AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR s.order_date <= m.valid_to)
    WHERE s.is_bundle = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    -- bundle SKUs: bundle -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT
        s.order_qty * b.qty * m.qty AS units,
        m.child_code AS model_code
    FROM sales s
    JOIN u_composition b
      ON b.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND b.parent_code = s.sku_code
     AND b.child_kind = 'sku'
     AND b.valid_from <= s.order_date
     AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR s.order_date <= b.valid_to)
    JOIN u_composition m
      ON m.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND m.parent_code = b.child_code
     AND m.child_kind = 'model'
     AND m.valid_from <= s.order_date
     AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR s.order_date <= m.valid_to)
    WHERE s.is_bundle = TRUE
)
SELECT model_code
FROM model_units
GROUP BY model_code
ORDER BY SUM(units) DESC
LIMIT 3;
